intro_md: 🎧 **8 min. New listening – not the article again.** It's Friday afternoon: Nam has a short *end-of-week* chat with his manager, Claire. You know the topic (why the first week is tiring), but **everything you hear is new** – Claire gives Nam 3 tips for week 2. Listen first; the words are hidden.

parts.title: Friday chat: Nam and Claire
parts.md:
**Train your ears – the words are hidden at first:**
1. 👂 **Listen without the words.** Just follow. Missed a word? Keep going – the next sentence often explains it.
2. 👂 **Listen again**, still without the words. You'll catch more.
3. 📄 **Show transcript** – listen + read. **Tap any line** you missed to hear just that part again.
4. 👂 **Hide it** and listen one last time.

listen.text: Hi Nam, come in and sit down. How was your first week?
Honestly, I'm exhausted, but so far so good.
That's completely normal, so please don't worry.
In the meeting on Wednesday, I just nodded, but I didn't understand half of it.
Thanks for telling me, that's very honest.
Next time, just ask Tom to explain it again after the meeting.
Okay, I will. He talks very fast, though.
Well, Tom will be your buddy for the next two weeks.
You can ask him anything, even small questions.
That's great, thank you. Do you have any tips for next week?
Yes, three. First, write down each person's name with one small detail.
For example, "Sara, from Leeds, has two cats". It helps you remember people.
Second, prepare one or two questions for Monday's team meeting.
That's a good idea. It'll help me make a good impression.
Exactly. Third, take a real lunch break and walk outside for twenty minutes.
I usually eat at my desk, so I'll try that.
Good. You'll get used to everything soon, so take it easy this weekend.
Let's meet again next Friday at four and talk about week two.

parts.title: Quick check + how was it?
parts.md: A few quick questions – tap an answer, you see right away if it's right. Then tell me how much you understood, ask me anything below, and 📤 **Submit**.

questions.q: What will Tom do for Nam?
options: Be his buddy for two weeks
Take him to lunch every day

check.answer: Be his buddy for two weeks
